grid.layout_notes: Official 3-3-3-3-3-3; Train Enhancers can make all reels 6 high. 46,656 ways at 6^6.

respins.how_it_works: Riot Respins on 2 Bonus: Bonus→Molotov Wild, lock reels; extra Bonus during respins → +respin after payout.

expanding_reels.how_it_works: Train enhancer can make all reels 6 high; xWays can super-expand up to 20 high in base.

other.name: Jumping Wilds
other.how_it_works: In FS: Jumping / Burning Jumping Wilds reposition each spin; Burning-triggered Wild Mult enhancers persist; mults additive.

other.name: Train Enhancers
other.how_it_works: Trigger when Jumping/Burning Wild on same reel. Top: Wild Mult, xWays, Molotov, Extra spins, 6-high, Upgrade FS, Enable Bottom. Bottom: Wild Mult, Extra spins, Burning Jumping Wild.

wilds.name: Molotov Wild
wilds.behavior: Turns all positions above into Wilds; base, Riot Respins, and via FS enhancers.

wilds.name: Pipe Bomb Wild
wilds.behavior: Contains 2–4 Wilds; turns positions above into same-size Pipe Bomb Wilds; base and Riot.

wilds.name: Jumping / Burning Jumping Wild
wilds.behavior: FS only; reposition each spin; Burning makes Wild Mult enhancers persistent.

scatters.name: Bonus
scatters.behavior: 2 → Riot Respins. Higher Bonus tiers award DisOBEY / ChAos / Mass Transit BBQ (8 spins each; exact scatter counts not printed on CMS).

multipliers.name: Wild Multipliers
multipliers.behavior: Additive; persist when triggered by Burning Jumping Wilds.

specials.name: xWays / Super xWays
specials.behavior: 2–4 same inside; all Ways sync. Base can super-expand to 20 high when 4-high. FS: expand to 4 high with 4/6/8 of same. Mystery Symbol in main and FS.

specials.name: Burning cart
specials.behavior: Mass Transit BBQ: stops every spin; if holds Burning Jumping Wild, converts Jumping Wilds on its reel to Burning.

base_game_loop.summary: Ways on 3-3-3-3-3-3 (up to 46,656). Molotov/Pipe Bomb Wilds and xWays/Super xWays. xBet 2× guarantees special on reel 2. 2 Bonus → Riot Respins; higher Bonus tiers → DisOBEY (3 Jumping + top train) / ChAos (4 Jumping + both trains) / Mass Transit BBQ (+Burning cart). Buys 100–3,000×. Cap 30,144×.

phases.name: Configure xBet
phases.what_happens: Optional xBet 2×: guarantee Bonus/xWays/Super xWays/Molotov/Pipe Bomb on reel 2.

phases.name: Bonus check
phases.what_happens: 2 Bonus → Riot Respins; higher Bonus → DisOBEY/ChAos/BBQ free spins.

base_game_loop.notes: Exact Bonus counts for DisOBEY/ChAos/BBQ not on CMS — listed as escalating scatter tiers.

modes.name: Riot Respins
modes.spins_awarded: Respin mode (not fixed FS count); +1 respin per additional Bonus after payout.
modes.sticky_or_persistent_state: Bonus→Molotov Wild; reels with Wilds locked.
modes.end_condition: No new Bonus / We Want You 30,144×.

phases.name: Riot
phases.what_happens: Convert Bonus to Molotov; lock wild reels; respin.

modes.name: DisOBEY Spins
modes.trigger: Bonus scatter tier (exact count not printed).
modes.progressive_state: Additive Wild Mults; Burning makes them persistent.
modes.effects: 8 FS; 3 Jumping Wilds; top enhancer train.

modes.name: ChAos Spins
modes.trigger: Higher Bonus tier than DisOBEY (count not printed).

modes.name: Mass Transit BBQ Spins
modes.sticky_or_persistent_state: 4 Jumping Wilds; both trains; Burning cart every spin.
modes.progressive_state: Burning converts Jumping→Burning on cart reel; persistent Wild Mults.

bonus_free_spins.notes: DisOBEY/ChAos/BBQ scatter counts not printed on CMS.

options.effects: Buy Riot / DisOBEY / ChAos / BBQ variants.

feature_buy.notes: Exact line prices inside band not printed.

ante_bet.effects: xBet 2×: special symbol guaranteed on reel 2.
